inside_view_explanation: Starting from a 15.0% base rate, our model moderately decreases the probability to 12.7%. The key factors are: incumbent_party_status, age_and_generational_appeal, florida_base_strength. Most influential: incumbent_party_status (47%), maga_movement_evolution (26%), field_strength (21%).

base_rate.reference_class: Sitting or recent Cabinet secretaries seeking Republican presidential nomination
base_rate.reasoning: Since 1976, approximately 20 Cabinet-level officials have seriously pursued GOP nominations. About 3 won (Bush Sr., Trump's cabinet members didn't win, but historical figures like Alexander Haig failed). Base rate reflects Cabinet experience advantage but difficulty of transition.
